captions.text: PackOverflow here. What do you need to know?
Hi, I have a meeting with the bank in ten minutes about the nightly payroll export. Who actually knows how the retries work?

Marc's your person here. He corrected that you retry the upload three times, not five, because the bank closes the SFTP window at six in the evening and a late export gets rejected anyway. He reasoned through this twelve days ago. Sofie's been busiest on it, but she mostly went along with what the AI suggested. This is going dark though, only Marc still thinks about it. Want me to ping him?

Marc corrected that you retry the upload three times, not five, because the bank closes the SFTP window at six in the evening and a late export is rejected anyway. He also decided to start the export at five in the afternoon, so a failed upload still has an hour before the window closes.
I'd send that to Marc now. Good luck with your meeting!
